column10: dig_threshold_desc:I would sometimes leave after gathering more than 50% of the gems.  Sometimes however I would stay a little longer trying to gauge how I could maximize the gems.
column13: I noticed the second dig would have considerably less gems. On those I wouldn't stay unless I had more gems than usual in the first dig.
column18: feedback:I had to keep pressing the A key over and over many times for the program to acknowledge I was pressing the key. Once or sometimes twice wasn't enough. }
